description: Illumination sweep: per case, one row per image (frames) and the statistics of the windows of the brightness check binned by the shadow ratio S (S), by the angle phi between sun azimuth and local strike (rule_phi), by sun elevation (rule_elevation), by the side of the fracture plane the sunlight comes from (sun_side) and by threshold (thresholds). The window values themselves are in light_sweep_windows.npz (window_table).
paper_items: supplement S4: illumination sweep and the shadow ratio; tables of the readings binned by S, of the numbers of windows per bin and of the fractions binned by phi

units.darkness: brightness difference, adjacent-rock ring minus in-fracture band, grey levels of the 8-bit image (Rec. 709 luma)
units.low_contrast_share: fraction of valid windows with |band mean - ring mean| below 2 grey levels
units.S_bin: shadow ratio S = (d / w) |s.n| / (s.a); the last bin holds the windows with infinite S (s.a <= 0)
units.phi_bin: angle between sun azimuth and local strike of the window, degrees
units.s_dot_n_up: component of the unit vector towards the sun along the upward normal of the fracture plane
units.mean_luma: mean Rec. 709 luma of the rock pixels of the 8-bit image, 0-1
units.length_share: image length of the windows that are not unclear / image length of the windows of a class
units.tag: aAAAeEEsS: sun azimuth AAA and elevation EE in degrees, render seed S (frame <case>_<tag> of sweeps.csv)

notes: Statistics use the images with render seed 0 whose mean rock brightness is at least luma_limit, and the valid windows. Bins with fewer than 30 windows carry enough_windows = false.

strike classes: the windows are assigned by their local strike to the nearer of the strike azimuths 60 and 150 degrees (the two joint sets of the scene configuration). These classes are not the joint sets: at both viewpoints the traces in frame belong almost entirely to one set (strike_groups.visible_paths); the local strike of the windows is widely scattered.

floor_visibility_straight_slot: for a straight, parallel-walled fracture the line of sight through a sample reaches the floor when w |v.inward| / |v.n| >= d (v: viewing direction, n: fracture-plane normal, inward: depth axis); share over the in-frame samples of the base frame, with the 10th, 50th and 90th percentile of the fracture dip.

checks.W2: the brightness differences recalculated on the sweep image differ from those of the independently generated whole-chain frame by at most W2_cross_render_max_abs_contrast_diff grey levels (two renders of the same scene differ by one 8-bit level in a few tens of values) and every window is classified identically.

arrays.<case>__darkness: float32 (images, windows): ring mean - band mean of every window on every image, grey levels; NaN for a window without band or ring pixels. |darkness| is the brightness difference of the label rule.
arrays.<case>__ring_mean: float32 (images, windows): mean luma of the adjacent-rock ring, grey levels (stored for the two baseline cases; band mean = ring mean - darkness)
arrays.<case>__azimuth_deg, __elevation_deg, __: per image, in the order of cases.<case>.frames: sun azimuth and elevation, render seed, mean rock brightness below the limit
arrays.<case>__valid: bool (windows): the window has band pixels and at least 4 ring pixels
arrays.<case>__strike_deg: float64 (windows): local strike azimuth, degrees clockwise from north in [0, 180); NaN without geometry
arrays.<case>__n, __a: float64 (windows, 3): unit normal of the fracture plane and in-plane direction a (east, north, up); NaN without geometry
arrays.<case>__length_px: float64 (windows): image length of the samples of the window
arrays.<case>__path: int16 (windows): path number of the window (cases.<case>.strike_groups.visible_paths gives its source trace)

window_table.recompute: phi = angle between (azimuth mod 180) and strike_deg folded to 0-90; S = (depth_m / width_m) |s.n| / (s.a) with s = (sin az cos el, cos az cos el, sin el), infinite where s.a <= 0; low brightness difference = valid and not (|darkness| >= 2); statistics use the images with seed 0 that are not below the brightness limit and the valid windows.
window_table.precision: float32: the values differ from the float64 values of the analysis by less than 2e-5 grey levels; the script checks that the counts of every bin and threshold recomputed from the stored values equal those of the analysis.
